+"""R1 P2: Provider lifetime excludes pre-call registration and final persistence."""
+import asyncio,time
+import pytest
+from f6_cases import server,case,observe
+from f7_cases import registry,application,body
+from providers.mock import MockProvider
+from providers.base import ProviderStreamEvent
+from errors import ProviderCallError
+
+class SlowStream(MockProvider):
+    def __init__(self,delay=.5):super().__init__();self.delay=delay;self.elapsed=None
+    async def stream(self,model,messages,**kw):
+        self.stream_calls.append((model,list(messages)));self.stream_options.append(kw);start=time.monotonic()
+        try:
+            await asyncio.sleep(self.delay)
+            yield ProviderStreamEvent(delta='订单 A123')
+            yield ProviderStreamEvent(status='completed',upstream_terminal_received=True)
+        finally:self.elapsed=time.monotonic()-start;self.stream_close_calls+=1
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('stage',['registration','admission','terminal_save'])
+async def test_f7_provider_timer_excludes_nonprovider_stages(server,case,monkeypatch,stage):
+    name,config=case
+    models=registry({'general-primary':{'default_timeout_seconds':5,'max_timeout_seconds':5},'general-backup':{'default_timeout_seconds':1,'max_timeout_seconds':1}})
+    primary=MockProvider(error=ProviderCallError(code='provider_connection_error'));backup=SlowStream()
+    async with application(config,primary,backup,models=models) as (app,client):
+        if stage=='registration':
+            original=app.state.storage.begin_attempt
+            async def slow(trace,attempt,**kw):
+                await original(trace,attempt,**kw)
+                if attempt.model=='general-backup':await asyncio.sleep(.7)
+            monkeypatch.setattr(app.state.storage,'begin_attempt',slow)
+        elif stage=='admission':
+            original=app.state.streaming_manager._admit_provider
+            async def slow(rid,execution,start):
+                if execution.prepared.model_name=='general-backup':await asyncio.sleep(.7)
+                return await original(rid,execution,start)
+            monkeypatch.setattr(app.state.streaming_manager,'_admit_provider',slow)
+        else:
+            original=app.state.storage.finish
+            async def slow(trace,attempt=None,**kw):
+                if attempt and attempt.model=='general-backup':await asyncio.sleep(.7)
+                return await original(trace,attempt,**kw)
+            monkeypatch.setattr(app.state.storage,'finish',slow)
+        rid=(await client.post('/v1/llm/stream',json=body(timeout_seconds=5))).json()['data']['request_id']
+        response=await client.get(f'/v1/llm/stream/{rid}/events')
+        row,attempts,events=observe(server,name,rid)
+        assert row['status']=='completed',(stage,row['error_code'],backup.elapsed)
+        assert len(primary.stream_calls)==2 and len(backup.stream_calls)==1
+        assert attempts[-1]['status']=='completed'
+        assert backup.elapsed>=.49
+        assert events[-1]['event_type']=='response.completed'
+        assert 'response.failed' not in [e['event_type'] for e in events]
+
+async def test_f7_provider_timeout_still_bounds_actual_generation(server,case):
+    name,config=case;models=registry({'general-primary':{'default_timeout_seconds':5,'max_timeout_seconds':5},'general-backup':{'default_timeout_seconds':1,'max_timeout_seconds':1}})
+    primary=MockProvider(error=ProviderCallError(code='provider_connection_error'));backup=SlowStream(1.4)
+    async with application(config,primary,backup,models=models) as (_,client):
+        rid=(await client.post('/v1/llm/stream',json=body(timeout_seconds=5))).json()['data']['request_id']
+        await client.get(f'/v1/llm/stream/{rid}/events')
+        row,attempts,_=observe(server,name,rid)
+        assert row['status']=='failed' and row['error_code']=='provider_timeout'
+        assert len(backup.stream_calls)==1 and backup.elapsed<1.3

+"""R1 P2#2: error terminal persistence shares the original request deadline."""
+import asyncio
+from time import monotonic
+
+from errors import ProviderCallError
+from f6_cases import server, case, observe
+from f7_cases import application, body
+from providers.mock import MockProvider
+
+
+async def test_failure_terminal_save_timeout_defers_without_rewriting_attempt(server,case,monkeypatch):
+    name,config=case
+    primary=MockProvider(error=ProviderCallError(code='provider_auth_error'))
+    backup=MockProvider()
+    interrupted=asyncio.Event()
+    observed_deadlines=[]
+    async with application(config,primary,backup) as (app,client):
+        original=app.state.storage.finish
+        async def delayed(trace,attempt=None,**kwargs):
+            if kwargs.get('error_code')=='provider_auth_error':
+                observed_deadlines.append(kwargs.get('deadline'))
+                try:
+                    # Real Request/Attempt writes before this point have committed;
+                    # delay precedes the Request terminal transaction itself.
+                    await asyncio.sleep(1.3)
+                except asyncio.CancelledError:
+                    interrupted.set()
+                    raise
+            return await original(trace,attempt,**kwargs)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(app.state.storage,'finish',delayed)
+        start=monotonic()
+        response=await client.post('/v1/llm',json=body(timeout_seconds=1))
+        elapsed=monotonic()-start
+        assert response.status_code==504,response.text
+        assert response.json()['code']=='request_timeout'
+        assert elapsed<=1.25,elapsed
+        assert interrupted.is_set()
+        rid=response.headers['x-request-id']
+        trace=app.state.traces.requests[rid]
+        assert observed_deadlines==[trace._deadline]
+        async with asyncio.timeout(3):
+            while True:
+                row,attempts,events=observe(server,name,rid)
+                if row['status']=='failed':break
+                await asyncio.sleep(.02)
+        assert row['error_code']=='request_timeout' and events==[]
+        assert len(attempts)==1 and attempts[0]['status']=='failed'
+        assert attempts[0]['error_code']=='provider_auth_error'
+        assert len(primary.calls)==1 and not backup.calls
+        assert attempts[0]['provider_entered'] and attempts[0]['ended_at'] is not None

+"""R1 P2#3: actual stored F6 snapshot shapes survive an unchanged F7 registry."""
+from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
+import httpx
+import pytest
+from f4_cases import registry
+from f6_cases import server,case,body,observe,frames,poll
+from f7_stream_cases import ScriptedStream,success,failure
+from main import create_app
+from services.models import ModelRegistry,RecoveryPolicy
+from settings import Settings
+from utils.json_codec import dumps,loads
+
+
+@asynccontextmanager
+async def application(config,provider):
+    base=registry()
+    models=ModelRegistry(base.models,base.providers,recovery=RecoveryPolicy(base_delay_seconds=0.,max_delay_seconds=0.))
+    app=create_app(settings=Settings(env='test',_env_file=None),config_dir=config,model_registry=models,provider=provider)
+    async with app.router.lifespan_context(app):
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.ASGITransport(app=app,raise_app_exceptions=False),base_url='http://test') as client:
+            yield app,client
+
+
+async def create(client):
+    result=await client.post('/v1/llm/stream',json=body())
+    assert result.status_code==202,result.text
+    return result.json()['data']['request_id']
+
+
+def restore_f6_snapshot(server,name,rid):
+    row,attempts,events=observe(server,name,rid)
+    source=loads(row['input_snapshot'])
+    # F6 Gateway._snapshot contained exactly these six top-level fields and no
+    # fallback_models ModelConfig field (verified against frozen F6 source).
+    snapshot={k:source[k] for k in ('messages','model','provider','max_output_tokens','timeout_seconds','response_schema')}
+    snapshot['model'].pop('fallback_models',None)
+    with server.connect(name) as c:
+        c.execute('update tb_llm_request set input_snapshot=%s where request_id=%s',(dumps(snapshot),rid))
+    return snapshot
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('failed',[False,True])
+async def test_f7_review_unchanged_legacy_pending_executes_once(server,case,failed):
+    name,config=case
+    provider=ScriptedStream([[failure()] if failed else success(),success()])
+    async with application(config,provider) as (_,client):
+        rid=await create(client)
+        snapshot=restore_f6_snapshot(server,name,rid)
+        response=await client.get(f'/v1/llm/stream/{rid}/events')
+        row,attempts,events=observe(server,name,rid)
+        assert row['status']==('failed' if failed else 'completed'),response.text
+        assert row['error_code']==('provider_connection_error' if failed else None)
+        assert len(provider.stream_calls)==len(attempts)==1
+        assert attempts[0]['model']=='general-primary'
+        assert frames(response.text)[-1][1]==('response.failed' if failed else 'response.completed')
+        assert loads(row['input_snapshot'])==snapshot
+
+
+async def test_f7_review_legacy_pending_cancel_never_calls_provider(server,case):
+    name,config=case;provider=ScriptedStream([success()])
+    async with application(config,provider) as (_,client):
+        rid=await create(client);restore_f6_snapshot(server,name,rid)
+        await poll(client,rid)
+        response=await client.get(f'/v1/llm/stream/{rid}/events')
+        row,attempts,events=observe(server,name,rid)
+        assert row['status']=='canceled' and attempts==provider.stream_calls==[]
+        assert [x[1] for x in frames(response.text)]==['response.canceling','response.canceled']
+
+
+async def test_f7_review_legacy_terminal_replays_without_execution(server,case):
+    name,config=case;provider=ScriptedStream([success()])
+    async with application(config,provider) as (_,client):
+        rid=await create(client)
+        first=await client.get(f'/v1/llm/stream/{rid}/events')
+        assert observe(server,name,rid)[0]['status']=='completed'
+        restore_f6_snapshot(server,name,rid)
+        replay=await client.get(f'/v1/llm/stream/{rid}/events')
+        assert frames(first.text)==frames(replay.text)
+        assert len(provider.stream_calls)==1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('change',[{'fallback_models':('general-backup',)},{'max_output_tokens':2048},{'default_timeout_seconds':29}])
+async def test_f7_review_legacy_pending_rejects_real_model_change(server,case,change):
+    name,config=case;provider=ScriptedStream([success()])
+    async with application(config,provider) as (app,client):
+        rid=await create(client);restore_f6_snapshot(server,name,rid)
+        manager=app.state.streaming_manager;old=manager.registry
+        models=dict(old.models)
+        models['general-primary']=models['general-primary'].model_copy(update=change)
+        manager.registry=ModelRegistry(models,old.providers,recovery=old.recovery)
+        result=await client.get(f'/v1/llm/stream/{rid}/events')
+        row,attempts,events=observe(server,name,rid)
+        assert row['status']=='failed' and row['error_code']=='execution_configuration_changed'
+        assert attempts==provider.stream_calls==[]
+        assert frames(result.text)[-1][2]['code']=='execution_configuration_changed'
